home.agg_testo: Impaginatore restarts by itself. Your work is already saved and your albums don't change.
home.aggiornato: Updated: Impaginatore will reopen by itself in a few seconds…
home.assist_nota: If you turn this on, photo thumbnails and spread previews, reduced (1200 pixels on the longest side at most), go to the AI assistant and so to its provider, outside your computer. The originals stay here. Photos can show people who can be recognised: turn it on only if you can do so for your clients. The assistant can't change this setting.
home.assist_testo: An AI assistant connected to Impaginatore (MCP, for example Claude) reads and edits your albums: you see every change in the editor and undo it like your own. By default it receives text only: file names, proportions, dates, layouts and check results.
home.cestino_testo: The album goes to the Trash with the photos in its own folder and its previews: you can restore it from there. Photos kept in other folders stay where they are.
home.chiuso: Impaginatore has closed. You can close this tab.
home.crea_frase: Your photos stay where they are, on your computer: the album reads them from there.
home.crea_titolo: A new album starts from a folder of photos
home.dim_label: Size of the open album (two pages), in cm
home.editor_non_parte: The album didn't open. Try again; if it happens again, look at the editor.log file in the albums folder.
home.foto_label: Photo folder (optional: without one, the album uses a Photos folder inside itself)
home.lic_chiave_label: Licence key (it's in your purchase email and starts with IMP1-)
home.lic_senza_internet: The key is checked here, on this computer, without the internet: it isn't sent to anyone.
home.lic_togli_testo: You can activate it on another computer. Your albums stay here; without a licence they open with the free trial, if it hasn't ended, or read-only.
home.lic_togli_titolo: Remove the licence from this computer?
home.lingua_nota: This applies to the whole program. Albums that are already open change language when you reopen them.

home.tornato_non_caricata: (only on this computer: I couldn't upload it to GitHub)
home.ultima_versione: You already have the latest version
home.ver_errore: I can't check for updates: maybe there's no internet connection. Impaginatore works anyway and your albums don't change.
home.versione_titolo: Version in use and update check
home.vuoto_testo: Choose the folder with your photos: Impaginatore prepares the album and the photos stay where they are, on your computer.
